light_description: Early G2D single-channel tone-enhancing overdrive, originating from the builder's 1984 customized Marshall/Boogie amplifier work.
G2D overdrive designed to package the Thunder Chief amplifier concept into a smaller commercial pedal; documented from 2000.
Vintage-voiced G2D overdrive with a solo boost, developed in 2002 and later documented with internal low-drive/low-bass options on later serials.
British-voiced G2D drive developed in 2002 with two operating modes and broad mid/top shaping.
G2D custom overdrive with Blues/Rock-oriented range and later internal bass/drive adjustment options.
High-gain G2D distortion developed in 2003 with proprietary Sensi-Gate control for tight percussive riffing.
Historical South African CraigAmps distortion product documented in early builder/community catalog evidence.
Historical South African smooth-overdrive model documented in CraigAmps-era product discussion.
Historical South African open, crunchier drive variant of VintageG.
Historical brighter/sharper overdrive-distortion model, also documented under a custom Woodmaul Distraction name in community evidence.
Historical bass fuzz product documented in early CraigAmps product discussion.
Historical transparent-boost product retained as a gain-adjacent boundary record.
Historical custom dual-gain build combining a Rangemaster-style boost section with a Les Lius-style overdrive section; retained as a custom-build record rather than a core catalog model.
Current Canadian handmade distortion pedal from the St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador builder.
Custom dual-mode recreation covering the documented Version 1 and big-box Version 2 Zendrive voicings.
High-headroom overdrive recreation using internal high-voltage power circuitry and NOS germanium clipping diodes.
Two-in-one pedal combining a Keeley-modded 808-style overdrive and Bennett's discontinued JFET boost, with switchable order.
Small-batch Tube Screamer-derived overdrive listed by Bennett Custom Audio as a limited/custom-shop build.
Digitally controlled but fully analog hexaphonic dirt processor with separate distortion channels for each guitar string and overdrive, crunch, and fuzz modes.
